Chapter 6497: You All Are Too Weak

Chapter 6497: You All Are Too Weak

“You all are too weak. This is it?” Li Qiye stretched inside while smiling.

He then left the cauldron without any issue and kicked the cauldron.

freē.com

“Boom!” The cauldron was sent flying while the droplet reverted to its original form.

Both dream realms showed numerous cracks while the primal ancestors felt their body crumbling.

Fortunately, the divine chains attached to the sources kept them together while the powers protected them from being decimated.

Li Qiye teleported before the woman with a speed too fast for anyone to react.

The startled woman’s first reaction was to exert the flute to the limit and play the most destructive note. However, it was too late as Li Qiye grabbed the flute. She mustered all her strength to pull it away to no avail.

“It shall return to its rightful master.” Li Qiye said.

She had no intention of losing it after spending so much effort on obtaining it. However, he couldn’t dodge his kick.

“Ahh!” She vomited blood while flying through the dream world, smashing into the wall of reality. She broke numerous mountains along the way and stained the ground red.

“Returning this to you, actually keep it this time.” Li Qiye tossed the flute into the abyss.

His enemies outside and allies in Gold Village became silent. He easily survived the attacks from two major realms and an immortal artifact.

They stared at him, feeling he could destroy the dream world with a single wave. Such a character was definitely a supreme overlord in the real world.

“W-who are you?” Man, the strongest in Trinity, couldn’t help but ask.

“Just a passerby.” Li Qiye gave the same answer as always.

“We were frogs under the well and couldn’t see Mount Tai, unaware of your arrival.” Immortal and Devil were afraid as well. His invincibility reminded him of Moshi.

“A bit too late now to ask for forgiveness.” Li Qiye said, causing Trinity to turn pale.

“It’s just death, I won’t blink even if you chop off my head.” Seventy-two shouted.

“Courageous.” Li Qiye said: “But also stupid. I don’t know how you made it to the primal realm but you have exhausted your parents’ goodwill.”

“Who are you?” Seventy-two asked again.

“He’s the one who convinced your parents to join Desolate Ancestor. He’s the reason why you became an orphan bullied by the world.” The longevity spirit’s voice came from the source of Paramount.

“You?!” Seventy-two’s expression became unsightly. He heard legends of a person who had influenced his parents. The sufferings as an orphan still tormented him to this day.

“Kill him.” The spirit spoke.

“Kill him.” The Lord of Paragon’s voice urged him as well.

Skyraiser’s group became afraid since they had sealed this lord into the source. How was he speaking?

“I will lend you a hand.” He spoke again.

The paragon power that had been dispersed by Li Qiye’s kick gathered again, rejuvenating the primal ancestors and bringing them back to their peak.

“Here is your chance to revenge, wash away your humiliation.” The longevity spirit persuaded.

“Boom!” The endless life force poured down and blessed Seventy-two and Trinity again.

The two realms returned to life, seemingly stronger than before.
